gait.source: Retain actual11999 gait1.0 using original bound source default0.5 override; no reward change relative to actual parent.

command_provenance: Exact saved12700 command ranges. Two of ten environment-index groups use the matched yaw audit vx and yaw magnitude. Both begin straight, then group 0 receives positive yaw and group 1 negative yaw. Original standing selection takes priority and the other groups retain the native sampler.
hypothesis: Instantaneous yaw tracking penalizes the alternating within-cycle yaw that a turning gait needs and rewards a common-mode pattern whose net average is near zero. Scoring the 1 s body-wz average should credit net turn per gait cycle and allow asymmetric steps, turning sustained right response on while preserving first-step response.
side_effects: A 1 s average can also credit slow natural drift and delay stop response; speed, loaded-foot tilt, alternating support and stop quiescence must be rechecked. No other variable changes.

std.source: Single-variable contrast from the exact saved12700 runtime: only the yaw tracking kernel std moves 0.1->0.3 rad/s; original bound source default0.5 is overridden to this target.

contact_lateral_tilt.source: Reconstruct exact saved12700 bilateral normal-force weighted moving cost from the original base.

yaw_window_override.source: Single-variable contrast from the exact model_12700 runtime at std 0.3: only the yaw tracking score changes from instantaneous body wz to the mean body wz over the last 1 s while forward walking with an unchanged command; reset/command change/stop clear the window and fall back to the instantaneous term.
